changes.title: No-tax-due threshold doubled to $2.47M; No Tax Due Report eliminated
changes.summary: Beginning with the 2024 report year, the no-tax-due revenue threshold increases from $1,230,000 to $2,470,000 of annualized total revenue, and the No Tax Due Report (Form 05-163) is discontinued. Entities at or under the threshold no longer file a franchise tax report at all but must still file a Public Information Report or Ownership Information Report. Combined groups whose revenue is under the threshold still file the group report. This changes the filing decision tree for every small-entity engagement versus 2023.
changes.who_is_affected: Taxable entities with annualized total revenue at or below $2.47 million, and their preparers.
changes.effective: Reports originally due on or after January 1, 2024.
